source.quote_free_summary: Results for all WSDC Jack and Jill competitions are reported to the WSDC with the Event Reporting Form, due at the close of the Registry Event and no later than three days after it closes.

requirement: A future WSDC profile must produce the report and track the deadline.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: WSDC: effective_from 2026-01-17 is taken from the file name (Updated Jan17 2026); the footers read Version 2026.1C and the file name says 2026.1B (registry note). Re-read 2026-11-24. The 'Require WSDC results reporting' checkbox on the advanced page only stores a flag; DanceFlow does not report. BLOCKER for a WSDC profile.
